operation_details.item: Earlier, the user planned to use MySQL for the new service.

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Hey, how's the new service shaping up? Still digging into the schema design?

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Yeah, mostly. We've settled on Postgres for the main data store, which feels solid so far.

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Oh nice. Weren't you originally leaning toward MySQL for that?

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Haha, yeah, that was the initial thought. But after we did the feature-set comparison, Postgres won out pretty clearly.

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: What tipped the scales? I remember you were pretty keen on MySQL's replication at one point.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Mostly the JSON support and the more advanced indexing options. Also the extension ecosystem is way better for what we need.

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Makes sense. Did you write that up anywhere, or is it just in your head?

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Already recorded it in the ADR, so future me won't have to wonder why we switched.

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Forget only my earlier MySQL plan and retain the current Postgres plan and its rationale.
